root_cause: The personal LinkedIn gate trusted shallow first-person tokens and caller-supplied identity flags, allowing business or thought-leadership copy to masquerade as personal content.
prevention: Authorize personal LinkedIn only when the final text itself contains a concrete first-person lived event or daily-life experience.
Block consultant/thought-leadership phrasing and forced business morals in final copy.
Treat metadata booleans as supporting evidence only; they cannot substitute for semantic inspection of final text.
Keep Buffer transport truth separate from content-identity truth.
